Good day! You look like an adventurer...\nSo you are indeed! Welcome!\nThere are many valuable books in this library.
Although not for free, you may read all of them.\nSo read them when needed. If you wanna know more,\nask Lilulu, the chief librarian at the reception...
Also, if you don't mind, I'd love to listen to\nyour adventure stories and keep a record of them.\nPlease consider.
Oh, hi adventurer! You've gone through so many\ndangers on your journey, have you?\nWould you be kind enough to share your stories?
An intriguing one or exhilarating one. I'd like to\nkeep a record of various adventure stories...\nI won't force you, but if possible, please...

Hey there. What's up?\nWell... I'm not quite myself these days...
I guess I need to touch something interesting to\nconcentrate on work.
You know what?\nA lot of ancient weapons were found\nin the ruins recently.
The ancient craftsmanship will get me motivated\nif I can touch the weapons...
Hey, there. What can I do for you?
Thanks. Have a nice day.
...Huh? Holy gems?\nYes, I know about them.\nThey're used to defeat monsters, right?
I'm a blacksmith, so I don't really know much\nabout them. I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help.
Hey there. How can I...\nHuh? Make an ornament with them? Umm...\nI'm good at metalwork but...
I guess [ffff64]Lefina[ffffff] is good at this kind of thing.\nShe lives in the mansion near the main street.\nShe often makes and shows off her flower works.

I was running a shop in the temple town located\nsouth of this city but... I moved here because\nthe monsters are increasing in number there.
The shop? I'm using it as a storage but it's badly\ndamaged. And my age began to tell on me, so it's\nreally hard for me to go there.
...Oh, you can do that for me?\nThanks. I'll ask for your help then.
Hi. How can I help you?
Thank you. Hope to see you again.\nYes, I'll be waiting for you.
Hi. How can I help you?\nAh, holy gems?\nYou found them useful, right?
Various types of holy gems are under development,\nso they'll be much more useful...
Where are they made? I have no idea...\nResistle people are creating them but they're\nkinda secretive, so we can't get any information.
Hi. Welcome. Hm? A cake?\nOh, well I used to make cakes but I don't have\nan oven here.
Who's good at it? Hmm...\nMaybe Frente who's near the general store?\nWhy don't you ask her?
Hello. ...Oh? I feel like we've met before...\nMaybe in a city but I'm sorry I can't remember.\nI've met many people because of my job, so...
By the way, we got in so much trouble.\nThe dragon attacked our town and we had no time\nto bring our goods out.
My husband said he left something behind, so he\nwent back to the town. But since then, he went\nmissing for a month! It was miserable...
Eh? My husband? He's alive. I thought he'd return\nwith the things that survived the fire. Instead,\nhe bought many things and went to the town again.
He said it's a business opportunity because there\naren't any shops although people often pass there.\nI didn't know he was that shrewd. Ha ha.
Hello!\nHey, how many skills have you acquired?\nOh, I see. Then you wanna learn more, don't you?
This library has a lot of valuable skill books.\nIt's meaningless just to put them in the\nbookshelves, so we lend them out to make money...
...Huh? You thought it was free? No way!\nI'm running the library, you know?\nFee? It depends.
The more difficult it is, the more costly it is.\nIf you learn a skill and continue to the next\nskill, it costs even more. Be careful.
Did you understand the book? It's easy, isn't it?\nHope you'll come again..\nwith your purse full of money! Tee hee!

Hey, there. Are you an adventurer, too?\nYou started your adventure recently, didn't you?\nMe? It's been 30 years.
Well, nice to meet you.\nShall I give you some useful info for your\nadventure if you like?
Status Ailments

Proration

When you take damage from monsters, you may\nsuffer from[ffff64]Status Ailments[ffffff] such as Flinch,Tumble,\nPoison, Paralysis...
[ffff64]Flinch, Tumble and Stun[ffffff] immobilize you\nfor a while. If you're using a skill, it'll be\nstopped and [ff6464]you can't move for a while.[ffffff]
[ffff64]Poison[ff6464] decreases your HP\neverytime you attack. So, you should stop\nattacking the enemy.
[ffff64]Paralysis[ffffff] greatly reduces ASPD (Attack Speed).\nIt has no effect on skills but normal attacks\nwill become really slow.
[ffff64]Slow[ff6464] makes your [ff6464]movement speed[ffffff] slow.\nIf you are using a bow or magic, it's difficult\nto keep distance from the monsters.
Phew, let's call it a day.\nYou can't memorize all at once, can you?\nI'll teach you the rest next time.
Have you seen [64ffff]red zones on the ground[ffffff]?\nIt shows [64ffff]the area of the monster's deadly attack.[ffffff].
If you stay in the zone, you may take great\ndamage, so you should step out the zone quickly.
It's not really unavoidable but you'll need\nextremely high dodge rate... Hm? Me?\nI'd just get out of the zone.
There are 3 types of attacks: Normal Attack,\nPhysical Skills and Magic Skills. But if you\nrepeat the same type of attacks...
[ff6464]The damage dealt may gradually decrease.[ffffff]\n[64ffff]Enemies get used to the attack and it\nbecomes less effective.[ffffff]
But it might be a chance. When enemies get used\nto the attack, the defense against other types of\nattacks gets weak.
So, if an enemy gets used to normal attacks,\nyou can deal more damage than usual with\nphysical and magic skills.
Well, some monsters get used to attacks easily,\nsome don't. So when you notice the damage dealt\ndecreases, you should change the type of attacks.
The books teach me everything...\nThe books in the library are my teacher...
What are you talking about?
Just leave
Oh! You want new knowledge and abilities too?!\nI know just how you feel! You're not satisfied\nwith yourself, right?! Yeah!
[ffff64]If you want to get new skills, just read books.[ffffff]
Listen! You can borrow books at the library!!\nWell, we are supposed to read them here because\nwe are not allowed to bring them out.
You can learn lots of skills. Sounds nice, huh?\n[ff6464]Learning many skills is not always a good thing.[ffffff]\nYou'll find it difficult to learn another one.
It takes more time to read the books, so you'll\nneed more Spinas to borrow the books.\nJust keep it in mind.
Ask about something...?

You need to equip designated weapons to use\n[64ffff]Weapon Skills[ffffff] but they're very strong!\nYou should level up the first skill you learn.
You can use some magic and knuckle skills with\ndifferent weapons but they're gonna be much\nweaker. So, check your weapons!
For instance, Martial Skill [Bash] will deal\nless damage if equipped with weapons other than\nKnuckles. And less likely to Stun enemies.
[64ffff]Buff Skills[ffffff] might be good if you are using\nshields or daggers. I guess Weapon Skills are\nbetter but some skills could be useful.
Oh, yes. [ff6464]Guard skills are useless unless you\nremodel armors.[ffffff] So, make sure you have the\nremodeled one if you wanna learn them!
[64ffff]Support Skills[ffffff] mainly boost stats. You can\nheal HP and boost their stats with Support Skills.\nAlso, you can boost your stats with Battle Skills.
Especially, [ffff64]Survival Skills[ffffff] are really useful!\nThe skill to increase MaxMP is very recommended!\nYou can learn it with Survival Skill Lv2.
Hmm, how should I remodel my armor...\nHmm, what should I do...
Remodel armor?
Leave
Hm? Oh, hello adventurer. What?\nRemodeling armor? Yea, you can [ffff64]remodel clothes and\narmors at blacksmiths' one time per equipment[ffffff].
If you make them light weight, [ffff64]attack speed\nand dodge will be enhanced. Also, you'll be able\nto perform Evasion[ffffff] [ff6464]at the cost of defense[ffffff].
If you make them heavy weight, [ffff64]defense will be\nenhanced and you can perform Guard[ffffff] [ff6464]at the cost\nof dodge and attack speed[ffffff].
Once you remodel the equipment, you can't restore\nit to its original state. So, you might want to\nkeep a spare with you or think before remodeling.
Welcome. You wanna refine metal?\nOr strengthen weapons?
...What? An errand?\nFrom Sololo?
Oh! That's scrap metal!\nYou brought it all the way here!?\nOh, how nice of you!
I would have visited him if I knew it...\nThank you so much.
Hm? Sorry but is this your first time here?\nYou look like a Straye but I haven't seen you\nbefore so...
You're traveling all over the world and looking\nfor the purpose of your life, aren't you?
I can understand Cule peddlers and monks but...
I really don't understand adventurers like...\nOh, I'm sorry for mumbling.
We, Fixion settle down in a place, so you may\nthink we are down-to-earth people but...
We're living under the threat of monsters.\nAnd no matter how hard we work, we don't\nmake much money...
But I'm too scared to go on an adventure.\nI can't use magic like Resistle people.
I don't have knowledge of machines and science like\nTechnista people... So, blacksmith might be\nthe best choice for me...
Oh, I'm sorry for complaining.\nI shouldn't have said such a thing to you.
Well, thanks for delivering the scrap!
Please take an armor you like.\nIt's the token of my appreciation.
Please don't hold back.\nYou look... Ah...
It's too dangerous to go on with your equipment.\nSure, please take it.
It has a strange dent...
I guarantee it's a good armor.\n...What? A dent?\nOh, that's a [64ffff]Slot[ffffff].
You can put a [64ffff]Crysta[ffffff] into it and enhance\nthe durability of the equipment or your ability.
About [64ffff]Crystas[ffffff]?\nYou might want to ask a professional.
I don't really know much about them.\nI'm just a blacksmith so...
...By the way, why don't you [ffff64]go to the land under\ndevelopment[ffffff] and try the armor?
Straye people must be there to hunt the monsters.\nWhy don't you talk to them?
...Lots of unfamiliar words.\nNeed to [ffff64]go to the land under development[ffffff] and\n[ffff64]ask Straye people about them[ffffff]...
Hi, welcome.\nHow can I help you today?
...Oh? Oh, oh!\nFrom Balft and Triel, right?\nThank you so much!
Oh, but...\nI haven't seen you before, have I?\nYou came to this city for the first time?
...I see. It's a large city, isn't it?\nBut half of the city was lost to the cataclysm\nlong time ago and it was about to disappear.
But now, it's the largest city around here.\nLook at the new buildings!
It's all thanks to Pino, the Goddess of Wisdom...
Oh, oh, looks like I'm talking too much.\nThanks for the delivery.
See you! ...?\nYou wanna ask something?\n...Sure, ask me anything.
What is a crysta?
Nothing.
Just a second...\nThis is a [ffff64]Crysta[ffffff].
Every crysta has its own attributes and...\nWhen you put it on the equipment,
you can use the power of the crysta.\nBut you know,
Goddess Beads, which are the materials of crystas,\nare severely depleted because they've been used\nfor hundreds of years.
Besides, a lot of the beads were lost because of\nthe cataclysm.\nSo... it's really difficult to create a crysta.
Oh yea? Alright...\nHm? This? It's a [ffff64]Crysta[ffffff].
Every Crysta has its own attributes and...\nWhen you put it on the equipment,\nyou can use its power.
Oh, yes. Do you have equipment with a slot?\nGreat, you have one.
This is a special gift for you.\nTry it on! Here you are.
If you wanna synthesize something, come to me.\nYou're welcome.
Hi. What's wrong?\n...Purification Incense? Okay, let me see...
Alright, you have all the materials.\nJust a moment.
Here you are.\nThis is Purification Incense.\nIt's really effective.
So, are you traveling with Balft and Triel now?\nThat's nice.
They're pretty skilled and tidy, so you can learn\na lot from them.
Keep up the good work.\nSee you.
Welcome.What kind of book do you... Huh?\nYou wanna look up something? Hmm, sorry.\nI don't lend books to keep them in good condition.
Huh? You're asking me to search?\nWell, I'm used to dealing with books but...\nIt's just a pain.
Oh, having said that, I bet you don't really\nknow about the books here, right?
What did you say?! No way!!\nFine! What do you want, then?!
So, you wanna find out what it is, huh?\nJust a minute. I'll go get it!
Hey, sorry. I bragged that I would find it but\nthere were no books about this drawing or similar\nthings.
Most things should be described in these books...
Leave the library
It never existed before?
I'm so sorry.\nI'm looking forward to your next visit.
Things not in the books?\n...Hmm, was there one, oh no, two things?
What are they?
They are about ancient weapons.\nThings like that are treated as confidential, so\nthey are barely recorded in books...
Anyway, I'm sorry I couldn't be of any help.\nI'm looking forward to your next visit.
So, it could be dangerous?
Kurgon also said it could be a kind of magical\nweapon... Anyway, you couldn't get any clues.\nNow you are back where you started...
Hey, [ffff64]Goddess Pino[ffffff] has seen the whole world for\na long long time, right?\nShe might know something about it, right?
